notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-load-set (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): CALDST LOADs the defined program CALDTG. LOAD PROGRAM SET(ptr) LENGTH(len) then RELEASE; each result is a 12-byte record in TS queue LDLOG (tag, RESP, RESP2, pointer flag, LENGTH flag). CALDTG is installed but never run. The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: load
scenarios.why: pointer preset null and LENGTH preset 0; after the LOAD of a defined program the pointer is set and LENGTH is above zero, RELEASE completes NORMAL
